purpose: Implement the missing zero-authority HORIZON-A field-entry source observer for HARM-Delta's matched physical G comparator without reading the active HORIZON experiment or changing either mechanism.

dependencies.required_evidence: Bind source SHA-256 ff08edea191055ceecc23ebf6008e1aaa2f0f573c1a005b61d6a48c45be68b8a and its repeated causal source-census decision SHA-256 26afdc413eb4200279f9061e28569090bf98053c0fb8ad4d8d4f08ff658dfae4.
Preserve the exact G source law and HARM callback timing; G changes only physical versus semantic donor selection under the identical edit machinery.
Production output must satisfy the already measured HGS1 format and repeat boundary.
Production observation requires exact repeated GSRT2 and selects only decoder-visible explicit-field-entry event type 2 before the target truth.

source_law.context: The exact preceding 16 decoded WRT bytes before target coordinate c.
source_law.hash: Unsigned modulo-2^64 polynomial hash with base 0x9e3779b185ebca87 and base^16 0x6fe6ef9fbd3b9581.
source_law.table: 2^24 direct-mapped Record{uint32 high-hash tag,uint32 continuation_plus_one} slots.
source_law.retention: At each coordinate i >= 16, install continuation i only when the slot is empty or its high-32-bit tag differs; otherwise preserve the oldest same-tag continuation.
source_law.eligibility: Before target truth, require nonempty slot, exact tag, source in [16,c), c-source strictly greater than 100000000, exact 16-byte historical context equality, and source+512 <= c.
source_law.field_entry: Observe only unique GSRT2 event-type-2 availability coordinates inside the replay interval. Multiple entry callbacks at the same coordinate share the same prospectively selected physical donor.
source_law.transition_witness: Before each field-entry lookup, record the HORIZON-A FNV transition state after coordinate c-1. Each posttruth update hashes i, pretruth rolling hash, slot index, old record, retained/new record, and truth in the exact source-census order.
source_law.update_order: Consume all callbacks available at c, perform the field-entry lookup, then read truth c, update the anchor table and transition witness, and finally roll the context hash.

production_identity.rule: A future production run over the complete bound WRT stream must reproduce all three frozen source-census terminal witnesses before any HGS1 output becomes admissible.

fixture.geometry: A generated 128-byte WRT stream, 16-byte contexts, 2^8 slots, age strictly greater than 32, and two unique field-entry targets.
fixture.scope: The reduced table and age exercise the unchanged lookup, retention, exact-context, pretruth, transition, and rolling-hash equations; they prove no production population result.
fixture.reference: An independent Python implementation must reproduce every emitted target/source/context/transition row and terminal rolling, table, and transition witness.
fixture.container_bridge: A clearly labeled fixture-only coordinate lift may place the already verified rows into production-valid HGS1 geometry solely to recheck the measured HGS1 parser and causal donor reconstruction. It grants no source-coordinate evidence.

negative_controls: routed callback with zero route identity
active_horizon_rule: The managed v1 fixture accepts no corpus, store, production route-tape, or HORIZON result path and must never stat, open, hash, mmap, or semantically inspect the active HORIZON namespace.
future_execution_rule: Production A/B observation is a new activation-gated experiment after the exact HORIZON terminal router and repeated corpus GSRT2 terminal receipts exist. The observer output remains forbidden submission input and zero credit.
